hints.title: Suffix Domain Generation
hints.text: Extract all hierarchical domain suffixes for each entry and aggregate their counts.

hints.title: String Splitting by Period
hints.text: Split the domain string by dots to iteratively generate the top-level, second-level, and full domain keys.

hints.title: Map Aggregation and Formatting
hints.text: Accumulate counts per suffix in a frequency map, then convert entries into count domain formatted strings.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
from collections import defaultdict
from typing import List

class Solution:
    def subdomainVisits(self, cpdomains: List[str]) -> List[str]:
        counts = defaultdict(int)
        for cp in cpdomains:
            count_str, domain = cp.split()
            count = int(count_str)
            parts = domain.split('.')
            for i in range(len(parts)):
                subdomain = ".".join(parts[i:])
                counts[subdomain] += count
        return [f"{count} {sub}" for sub, count in counts.items()]
```

complexity.notes: Generates up to 3 subdomain keys per entry and aggregates frequencies.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Rebuilding and searching arrays linearly takes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash table stores counts for unique subdomains in O(N * L) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correctly split on space and period and generate all dot-separated suffix variations.
